name: QA Multi Screen Cap
description: Take multiple screenshots without losing any — capture the visible page or drag-select an area, collect everything in a gallery, and save all captures at once.
features: 📸 Capture the visible page in one click (or Alt+Shift+F)
✂️ Select a capture area by dragging on the page (or Alt+Shift+S), Esc cancels
🖼 Gallery keeps up to 100 captures across pages and tabs until you clear it
💾 Save one capture or all of them at once into Downloads/screencaps/
🔢 Badge on the toolbar icon shows how many captures are waiting
